settingsForm.name: States
settingsForm.hint: One row per state, and the first row that matches wins - drag the rows to change which. Fill in Value for an exact, case-insensitive match, or leave it empty and fill in Range from / Range to for a numeric band. Label is drawn under the lamp and Icon inside it; an empty label shows the raw value. true / on / yes / 1 and false / off / no / 0 count as the same value, so a boolean key needs no scripting.

settingsForm.name: Label for an unmatched value
settingsForm.hint: Leave empty to show the raw value itself.

settingsForm.name: Color for an unmatched value
settingsForm.hint: Used for a reading that matched no row above. See Label for an unmatched value for what counts as unmatched.

settingsForm.name: Icon for an unmatched value
settingsForm.hint: Used for a reading that matched no row above. See Label for an unmatched value for what counts as unmatched.

settingsForm.name: Lamp shape
settingsForm.hint: Round is the default. Square keeps the same tile and the same layout and only changes the lamp itself, so switching it moves nothing else on the card.

settingsForm.name: Show the data key name
settingsForm.hint: The caption above each lamp. With one entity it is the telemetry key's own name, as you configured it in Data. With several it becomes the entity, because that is what tells the lamps apart when they all carry the same key - and it becomes "entity · key" when the keys differ too. The tooltip and the screen-reader label always carry both.

settingsForm.name: Show the verdict chip
settingsForm.hint: The pill beside the entity name, showing the highest-priority state on the card - that is the topmost matching row, so drag the rows to change it.

settingsForm.name: Show the footer
settingsForm.hint: The muted row under the lamps: how many channels, how many are in the verdict state, how many have gone stale. The reading's age goes with it - the freshness stamp sits on the same row - so turning this off also hides "18h ago".

settingsForm.name: Word for one channel
settingsForm.hint: Renames only the count at the start of the footer, so "3 channels" can read "3 relays" or "3 pumps". The other segments are not touched: the state count already uses your own state label, and "stale" describes the reading rather than the thing.

settingsForm.name: Glow effect
settingsForm.hint: Draws a soft halo in the state's colour behind each lamp, and pulses it on a state whose Blink is on. A dimmed lamp does not glow or blink, so the halo never contradicts the stale signal.

settingsForm.name: Dim the lamp after (minutes)
settingsForm.hint: A lamp whose value has not been updated for this long is dimmed, stops blinking and is counted in the foot's stale total, so a device that went silent stops reading as green. Its exact age is in the lamp's tooltip. 0 turns the check off - which is the default, because attributes legitimately stay unchanged for days.

entity.description: Replaces the built-in Led indicator when two states are not enough: shows keys from one or many devices as labelled SCADA status lamps.
